article.title: Goods must be ascertained.
article.content:
18Goods must be ascertained.

Section 18  ·  Chapter III  ·  Transfer of property as between seller and buyer  ·  page 7 of the Act
Where there is a contract for the sale of unascertained goods, no property in the goods is transferred to the buyer unless and until the goods are ascertained.
